name: Lunokhod-1
about: Lunokhod-1 (1970-095, MOM), launched 1970 Nov 10. Its phases from GCAT: Luna. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
